name: io.github.smeet666/mcp-archiveorg
description: Search inside digitised books, browse the Internet Archive catalogue and read Wayback captures.

environmentVariables.name: IA_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Identify your own client. The project's own identifier is appended, so the Archive can always reach a human.

environmentVariables.name: IA_MIN_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum milliseconds between requests. Default 1000, floor 500.

environmentVariables.name: IA_HISTORY_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Deadline for the capture index, which answers in tens of seconds. Default 60000.

environmentVariables.name: IA_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: silent, error, info or debug. Default error. Logs go to stderr.
